parameters.name: ChangeSetId
parameters.description: The ID of the change set.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region to which the change set belongs. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~131035~~) operation to query the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions.

parameters.name: ShowTemplate
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to return the template. Valid values:

- true: The template is returned.

- false (default): The template is not returned.
